continuity: Taekyung publicly disclosed that The Black Wyvern’s Nest was a Mutated Gate containing a Named Monster and that he killed it.
Seven raid participants died, and Won Myunghoon’s death brought the confirmed total to eight; the remaining survivors were reported safe.
HunterTV streamed Taekyung’s statement live on iTube, quickly reaching 100,000 viewers.
The investigation confirmed Carus’s corpse and obtained conclusive raid footage; Kim Jonghun confessed to the Star Guild’s actions while still mentally shaken.
The leaked footage exposed additional wrongdoing and suspicions surrounding Won Myunghoon, producing intense public backlash.
plot: Jin Taekyung gives HunterTV an exclusive live broadcast outside The Black Wyvern’s Nest, publicly revealing that the Gate was Mutated and contained a Named Monster that he killed. He reports seven deaths among the raid participants, then adds Won Myunghoon to make eight and describes Won’s death as having been “disposed of.”

The emergency investigation confirms the Named Monster’s death. Kim Jonghun confesses everything while still mentally shaken, and an anonymous USB containing footage recorded with a concealed PSV-96K camera exposes Won Myunghoon’s conduct. Public anger over Won’s buried crimes and Taekyung’s killing of him intensifies.
translation_decisions: Render 처리했습니다 in Taekyung’s description of Won’s death as “disposed of him,” preserving the deliberately bureaucratic euphemism.
Render 합스부르폰 가 as Hapsburphon family and PSV-96K as the concealed camera’s product designation.

active_continuity: Taekyung completed the Manifestation of Qi Achievement, unlocking Spear Energy and Unaffected by a Hundred Poisons; he spent the resulting 100 Bonus Points on Strength and Stamina.
Taekyung’s Spear Energy and Scorching Yang Qi can penetrate high-level dragonkin defenses.
Carus, the One-Eyed Black Wyvern, could speak and cast magic strengthened by his dragonkin trait; Taekyung killed him at Level 115.
The Black Wyvern’s Nest was perfectly cleared as an A-Rank Gate, granting Taekyung enormous EXP and Fame, two displayed level-ups, and the Named Monster Defeated Achievement.
Taekyung remains publicly recognized as Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple and heir to the Fire Gate Clan’s orthodox lineage.
Jin Mukyung remains secluded in the training hall and has not returned to Heaven’s Gate Temple.
The Jin Family received an invitation to the Star-Array Grand Banquet in Henan.
Seong Jinho is staying at Taekyung’s new family home after losing his housing deposit to Kim Jong-su.
Taekyung is an A-Rank Hunter and nationally famous as the Tollgate Hero after the tollgate rescue and KPS interview.
The Peace Guild House has extensive magical communication, observation, and alarm systems, and media intrusion exposed Taekyung’s family’s personal information.

Won Myunghoon was a thirty-nine-year-old A-Rank Hunter, former ranker and celebrity entertainer, and CEO of the Star Guild; he led the ambush and was killed by Taekyung after attempting another attack after surrendering.
The joint Peace Guild-Star Guild raid was redirected to The Black Wyvern’s Nest; Won killed the Green Wyvern alone, Taekyung received no EXP, and Won lent him Yeti’s Necklace.
Taekyung killed forty-seven B-Rank Orc Warriors alone, and Im Kkeokjeong was among survivors he had rescued during an earlier E-Rank Gate attack.
Mutated Gates can contain monsters far above their expected Grade; Song Song rejected Taekyung’s confession but accepted friendship and a guildmate relationship.
The Peace Guild witnessed Taekyung kill Carus and now understands that his previously observed abilities represented only a fraction of his strength.
Carus’s corpse is more than fifty meters long and difficult to process; Taekyung feared using the Inventory to remove it because reporters were stationed at the Gate entrance.
The exit Gate opened unexpectedly after Won’s death and released around a dozen people before waiting reporters.
Butler Kim is an A-Rank mage who used Earthquake to incapacitate around a dozen veteran B-Rank Star Guild Hunters; Kim Jonghun was bound as bait before being found gagged and tied to a tree.
Taekyung publicly disclosed the Named Monster and Mutated Gate, reported eight total deaths including Won, and described Won’s death as having been “disposed of.”
Kim Jonghun later confessed fully, while an anonymous USB and note supplied concealed raid footage that exposed Won’s conduct and triggered intense public backlash.
open_questions: What additional rewards came from the Conception and Governor Vessels Quest, the Conception Vessel Opening, and the Named Monster Defeated Achievement?
Will Jin Mukyung return to Heaven’s Gate Temple before the appointed deadline?
What event does Jeok Cheongang believe may occur sooner than expected, and why must he endure for several more years?
What is the true condition of the absent Martial God?
Will Taekyung attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet, and what exactly was the answer that changed the three men’s expressions?
What are the Reward and Failure conditions of the Gate Suppression Quest?
Who are the roughly dozen people who emerged from the Gate, and what happened to them inside?
